# SimpliConvert

SimpliConvert (https://simpliconvert.com/) is a free online toolkit with 529 browser-based tools. All tools run 100% client-side in the user's browser: no sign-up, no uploads, no watermarks.

## Tool categories
- [PDF & Document Tools](https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools) — 15 tools
- [Image & Graphic Tools](https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools) — 60 tools
- [Calculators & Converters](https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools) — 228 tools
- [Developer & Coding Tools](https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools) — 51 tools
- [SEO & Webmaster Tools](https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools) — 36 tools
- [Social Media & Creator Tools](https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools) — 17 tools
- [Text & Productivity Generators](https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools) — 122 tools
